page.overview:
Who is Stormavik?

Stormavik is a member of the Oktober Guard.

Stormavik was part of the Oktober Guard team that was deployed to Afghanistan to retrieve a crashed spy plane. The team encounter their American counterparts, G.I. Joe. An intense firefight between the two devolved into a fistfight where Stormavik was beaten by Scarlett. A team-up with the Joes bring him to the Cobra stronghold in Iran. He joined with his leader Colonel Brekhov, Horrorshow, and Daina to infiltrate one side of the stronghold. While the other three infiltrated the base, Stormavik remained outside with the A.T.V. He was left behind with his Oktober Guard teammates fending for themselves against Cobra Troopers.

His code name may be inspired by the Il-2 "Shturmovik," a Soviet ground-attack plane that was used to devastating effect during World War Two.
